scope: Synthetic research aligned to declared aggregate bounds; not real predictive validation, business approval or production deployment
feature_contract: The same eleven MVP FEATURE_NAMES, snapshots before each evaluated granted loan
calibration: APF3_OWNER_ANCHORS_V4.json; its bytes and hash are frozen before generation

simulation.schedule: Rotate an absent group of 3 among 12 clients each week; 9 attend. The group absent next week has a repeat visit exactly 3 days later, making 12 scheduled opportunities. Member m=0,1,2 attends on m+randint(0,3-m); repeated visit adds 3. Consecutive scheduled visits stay 3..14 days, typical about 7. Policy refusals can lengthen granted-loan intervals.
simulation.amount_distribution: Rejection-truncated lognormal between 5 and 50, log-location ln(20), log-sigma 0.45; then limited by available exposure. Typical 20 anchors log-location, not an empirically estimated mean or distribution.
simulation.latent_lateness: One client propensity from Beta(p*3,(1-p)*3), p=8/45; sample planned payment behavior, then derive target from events. Stable latent heterogeneity is an unmeasured hypothesis, never a predictor or copied score.
simulation.partial_payment_probability: 10/48, independently sampled from late behavior; joint relationship is unknown
simulation.late_delay_distribution: Round rejection-truncated lognormal with log-location ln(4), log-sigma 0.55 to integers 1..15; typical 4 is an estimate, sigma is an assumption
simulation.payments: Every generated loan has a planned complete payment, possibly beyond observation; permanent loss rate is unknown and is not invented. Partial loans have two positive payments summing to the amount. Only events at/before the observation cutoff are observed.
simulation.overdue_policy: Reject a request with overdue debt unless every overdue loan already has a positive post-due abono visible before evaluation; then record simulated owner review. No unquantified payment-agreement exceptions are sampled.
simulation.cold_start: Record simulated identity/reference and owner review, with only the general max-loan bound; do not invent a separate initial amount
simulation.sales: Only linked granted-credit sales are modeled. Cash-sale history is not quantified by the source and is not invented.
simulation.deadline: Next calendar day; generated on-time payments occur at/before 20:00. Approximate business close is not a new timestamp field in the MVP. Grace does not relabel late payments as punctual.
simulation.population_and_calendar_status: Total client pool, stationarity across months, warmup length, weekday scheduling and latent distributions are explicit hypotheses, not owner measurements

replica_interpretation: Alternative independent synthetic histories of one business at its declared scale, never simultaneous branches or summed real business volume. No additional real information is created by replication.

hard_constraints: Observed payments positive, chronological and never exceed debt
12 scheduled opportunities and 9 scheduled distinct clients per full week
alignment_audit.policy: Development mean grant scale must pass before model fitting or final generation. Report attempted versus granted scale per replica. No forcing outcomes, labels or approvals to match source percentages. Final scale is audited and reported even if it fails, never regenerated or tuned.

cv.policy: Use largest declared fold count with both classes in every train/validation subset; fallback depends on training class adequacy only, never score/test. Stop if neither is possible.

svm_calibration.policy: Calibration splits only within each outer training subset; preprocessing fitted inside each calibrated estimator

review_policy.queue: Threshold then descending score, ties by fictional loan_id; daily key is replica_id + evaluation civil date. Never pool alternative replicas into one day.
review_policy.scope: Hypothetical alert reviews among granted synthetic loans, not all real requests or other mandatory human work. Capacity is an estimate, not measured operational feasibility.

selection.primary: OOF F2 of the capped review policy, beta=2
selection.rationale: Owner prioritizes unflagged delays qualitatively and estimates capacity 5/day. F2 remains a team research choice, not a measured cost ratio. The unrelated CV3 precision floor is not carried forward.
selection.success_proposal: Selected ML review-policy F2 must strictly exceed both Dummy baselines on final known labels, with cap respected. This baseline-relative team proposal is not an owner-approved recall target or proof of savings.
selection.oof_limit: OOF reused for hyperparameter/threshold search is optimistic for the winner; inner probability calibration is not nested hyperparameter evaluation. OOF queue only contains resolved development loans.

final_replica.generation: Only after frozen_selection.json and models exist
final_replica.policy: One batch score per frozen model on every granted final study loan, including unresolved ones for capacity; metrics only on known labels. Cache and reuse outputs. No final tuning, reseeding or regeneration.

old_data_policy: No CV3, v2, earlier tests or Doña Rosa rows used in training, calibration or selection
excluded_business_source: The previous wholly hypothetical owner form; only the current Rildo declaration anchors business parameters
publication: Local research revision only; no production change or automatic GitHub publication
